infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NoteFusion records short clips to transcribe them into solfa and staff notation, and listens for the key of a song while other apps play it.

plugins.faceIDPermission: NoteFusion uses Face ID to open Admin, so payments and accounts stay locked on a phone left unlocked.

plugins.microphonePermission: NoteFusion records short clips to transcribe them into solfa and staff notation, and listens for the key of a song while other apps play it.

plugins.photosPermission: NoteFusion lets you pick a photo from your library to use as your profile picture.
